name: Captain Live Chat
author: Devang Vachheta

sections.description:
Captain Live Chat is a free, self-hosted live chat plugin for WordPress. Add a real-time chat widget to your website, answer visitors from a Messenger-style agent inbox inside your WordPress dashboard, and keep every conversation in your own database. No monthly subscription, no per-agent fees, no external chat servers.

Unlike cloud-based services such as Tawk.to, Zendesk, Crisp or Tidio, Captain Live Chat stores all messages, visitor details and attachments on your server. It works out of the box on shared hosting, managed WordPress hosting and VPS, with simple AJAX polling instead of WebSockets.

Whether you run a small business site, a WooCommerce store, a support-heavy SaaS product, or an agency managing chat for multiple clients, you get a lightweight customer support tool that turns website visitors into conversations and leads.

YouTube | X | Facebook Community | Free Support | Captain Live Chat Pro

💬 A Real Live Chat Widget, Not a Contact Form

A floating chat bubble on the front end opens into a real-time conversation: pre-chat form, quick-reply chips, FAQ screen, typing indicators, read receipts, file attachments, and a dedicated offline lead-capture screen (with configurable name and email fields) when no agent is online. Visitors who come back can resume their conversation, and can start a fresh chat after a conversation is closed.

📥 Facebook Messenger–Style Agent Inbox

A modern, React-based dashboard with a thread list and chat panel side by side, plus a visitor info panel (browser, device, location and the live page the visitor is on). Agents add private notes and tags, assign conversations, mention teammates with @mentions, and switch themselves online or offline from their Profile. Agents stay online while any WordPress admin tab is open (also in the background) and go away automatically a couple of minutes after closing the admin. A short “Get your live chat ready” checklist helps new users send their first test message. Reopening a closed conversation, by the visitor or an agent, leaves a permanent, timestamped marker in the transcript.

📱 WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram & Telegram Contact Buttons

Give visitors every way to reach you from one place. Connect WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Phone, Email and custom links into a single unified floating launcher, so visitors never see overlapping bubbles. Choose how the channels appear: Speed Dial fan-out, quick buttons inside the chat panel, or an always-visible stack above the chat toggle. Control order, shape and position, and set channels per widget.

🎨 Multiple Widgets, Templates & a Live-Preview Designer

Create more than one chat widget with ready-made templates (Classic Chat and Action Hub) and customize each one in a step-by-step wizard with a live desktop and mobile preview: accent color, launcher icon, position and size, welcome screen, FAQ screen, chat view, offline experience, contact channels and display rules.

🎯 Smart Display Rules

Show or hide the chat per device (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), per page type (Home, Blog, Posts, Pages, Archives, Search results, 404, WooCommerce Shop and Products), on specific pages, posts and products you pick by title, or by visitor country (via Cloudflare / GeoIP headers). One “Live on website” switch turns the whole widget off, and the widget never shows inside page builder editors (Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Bricks, Oxygen).

🔔 Notifications That Actually Reach Agents

A live red badge next to the plugin’s menu item shows how many visitors are waiting, on every admin screen. Sound alerts, browser push notifications, in-app notifications (conversation reassignment, @mentions) and rate-limited email alerts make sure a new visitor message doesn’t sit unseen. A separate “Unanswered message reminder” re-emails agents if a conversation still hasn’t been answered after a delay you set, including messages left through the offline lead-capture form. Email templates (new message, unanswered reminder, conversation closed) are fully customizable with merge tags.

🔗 Instant Alerts to Telegram, Slack, Discord & Webhooks

Optionally forward new visitor messages to a Telegram chat, Slack channel, Discord channel, or any webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n or your own server), with a built-in test button and status tracking. All integrations are off by default.

👥 Role & User-Based Agent Permissions

Decide exactly who can act as a chat agent, by WordPress role (for example all Editors) or by picking individual users regardless of role. Fine-grained permissions control which pages and actions each agent can use, and every agent’s own Team Access row is protected from accidental self-lockout.

📊 Built-in Analytics, History & Data Retention

Track chat volume, response times and agent performance, and browse full conversation history. Optionally erase old closed conversations automatically after the number of days you choose, and wipe all plugin data on uninstall if you want a clean removal.

🔒 Privacy-Friendly & Secure by Design

All chat data stays in your own WordPress database. Visitor input is sanitized server-side, every AJAX endpoint is protected by nonces and capability checks, public endpoints are rate limited, and file uploads are validated by type and size. The core chat engine makes no third-party calls.

⚡ Lightweight & Shared-Hosting Friendly

The widget is minified and loaded with defer to protect your page speed, and polling slows down automatically while a browser tab is in the background to reduce server load.

🤖 AI-Ready (Abilities API & MCP)

On WordPress 6.9 or newer, the plugin registers its management actions as WordPress Abilities, so an AI assistant (through a separate MCP bridge plugin) can help manage your inbox. Every ability is off until you switch it on and requires the “manage_options” capability.

Perfect for:

  • Small businesses that want live chat without a monthly subscription
  • WooCommerce stores that need to answer pre-sales questions in real time
  • Support teams who need conversation history and analytics in their own database
  • Agencies managing chat for multiple client sites
  • Any WordPress site that wants visitor data to stay on its own server

Key Features

  • 💬 Floating Live Chat Widget : Pre-chat form, quick-reply chips, FAQ screen, typing indicator, read receipts, file attachments, resume and restart chat, and a dedicated offline lead-capture screen
  • 📱 Contact Channels & Unified Launcher : Connect WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Phone, Email, and custom links into a single floating launcher (Speed Dial, inside panel, or visible stack)
  • 🎨 Multi-Widget Designer : Create multiple widgets from templates (Classic Chat, Action Hub) with a step-by-step wizard and live desktop/mobile preview
  • 🎯 Display Rules : Show or hide the chat per device, page type, specific pages, posts and products, or visitor country. One switch turns the whole widget off, and it never shows inside page builder editors
  • 📥 Agent Inbox : Messenger-style thread list and chat panel, real-time polling, private notes, tags, assignment, @mentions, and a visitor info panel (browser, device, location, live current URL)
  • 👥 Role & User Permissions : Grant agent access by WordPress role or by individual user, with page/action permissions and self-lockout protection built in
  • 🔔 Notifications : Live unread badge in the admin menu, sound, browser push, in-app @mentions/reassignment alerts, and rate-limited email for new and unanswered messages
  • ✉️ Customizable Email Templates : Edit the New Message, Unanswered Reminder and Conversation Closed emails with clickable merge tags
  • 🔗 Admin Notification Integrations : Optional instant notifications to Telegram, Slack, Discord, or generic Webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n) when visitors send messages
  • 🟢 Online Status & Auto-Away : Online/offline switch in Profile, presence that stays live across every admin page and background tab, automatic away after the admin is closed
  • 📴 Offline Experience : A configurable lead-capture screen (welcome message, optional name/email fields, custom button text) shown when no agent is online
  • 🔁 Persistent Conversation Timeline : Closed/reopened events are saved permanently in the transcript, in the widget and the Inbox
  • 💡 Canned Replies : Quick, reusable responses with shortcuts and tags for agents
  • 📊 Analytics & History : Chat volume, response times, agent performance, and full conversation history
  • 🗑️ Data Retention : Optionally erase closed conversations automatically after a number of days you choose
  • 🔒 Self-Hosted & Secure : All conversations stay in your own WordPress database. Nonces, capability checks, rate limiting and validated uploads on every endpoint
  • ⚡ Lightweight : Minified, deferred widget scripts and AJAX polling instead of WebSockets, works on any shared host
  • 🌐 Translation & RTL Ready : Widget texts, messages and admin screens can be translated, and right-to-left languages are supported
  • 🤖 Abilities API / MCP Support : Optional, off by default, for AI assistants on WordPress 6.9+

Free vs Pro

Captain Live Chat is complete and fully usable on its own. For teams that want automation and extras, the optional Captain Live Chat Pro add-on appears directly inside your Captain Live Chat dashboard once activated (it requires this free plugin).

Captain Live Chat Pro adds:

  • 🤖 AI Agent Auto-Replies : Answer visitors 24/7 when no agent is online. Bring your own API key for Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic) or OpenRouter
  • 📚 Knowledge Base : Train the AI on your website links and .txt/.pdf documents for accurate, domain-specific answers
  • 🎛️ Custom AI Instructions & Usage Limits : Set tone and boundaries with a custom prompt, and cap daily and per-conversation replies
  • 👀 Live Visitors Dashboard : See who is on your site right now, which pages they view, where they came from, and start proactive chats
  • 👋 Proactive Greetings : Trigger greeting bubbles by time delay, scroll depth or exit intent
  • ⭐ Post-Chat Survey & CSAT : Collect star, thumbs or emoji ratings and track satisfaction in Analytics
  • ✉️ Email Chat Transcripts : Send formatted HTML transcripts to visitors or agents, optionally automatically when a chat is closed
  • 📤 Conversation Export : Export history to CSV or download individual transcripts
  • 🔔 Desktop Pop-up Alerts : Real-time pop-up notifications on any admin screen, with optional audio
  • 🏷️ White Label Branding : Replace the plugin name, author and logo across the admin for client sites
  • ♾️ Unlimited Canned Replies

See all Pro features and pricing

YouTube Tutorials

  • Captain Live Chat – Plugin Overview : See the whole plugin in action – the chat widget on your site, the agent Inbox, notifications, Widget Settings with display rules, canned responses, analytics and history.
  • AI Agent Auto-Reply Setup Tutorial (Pro Add-on) : Step-by-step tutorial for the Captain Live Chat Pro add-on on connecting Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or OpenRouter for intelligent 24/7 automated replies when agents are offline.

🌟 Our Products

🥇 Captain Feed for YouTube : Display customizable YouTube feeds for channels, playlists, Shorts, search results, and individual videos.

🥇 Captain Funnel : Automate WhatsApp messages for WooCommerce orders and form submissions using the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful Elementor widgets and elements.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts and easy customization.

Source Code

The admin dashboard is a React application built with @wordpress/scripts (npm + webpack). The published files in the build/ folder are the compiled output of the human-readable source (JSX/SCSS), which is publicly available at:

https://github.com/devangvachheta/captain-live-chat

To rebuild from source:

  1. Clone the repository above (it includes the src/ folder and package.json).
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies.
  3. Run npm run build to produce fresh files in build/ from the src/ source.
  4. For active development with automatic rebuilds, use npm run start instead.

Usage

After activation:

  1. Set up agents – Under Settings, allow specific WordPress roles or individual users as chat agents.
  2. Customize the widget – Use the Widget Settings wizard to set accent color, welcome screen, chat view, contact channels, and the offline lead-capture experience.
  3. Choose where it shows – Use Display Rules to show the chat only on the devices, pages or countries you want.
  4. Go online – Turn on the Online Status switch on your Profile page so visitors see an active agent. You stay online while WordPress admin is open.
  5. Reply in real time – New visitor messages appear in the Inbox within a few seconds via polling.
  6. Get alerted – Enable sound, browser, email, or Telegram/Slack/Discord/Webhook alerts so no message is missed.
  7. Review performance – Check the Analytics tab for chat volume, response times, and history.

External Services

Captain Live Chat does not connect to external services by default. The chat engine operates entirely within your WordPress installation.

Optional features that send data when explicitly enabled by an administrator:

  1. Telegram Alerts: Sends new message alerts to the Telegram Bot API (https://api.telegram.org). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Telegram Terms | Privacy Policy
  2. Slack Alerts: Sends message alerts to your Slack Incoming Webhook (https://hooks.slack.com). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Slack Terms | Privacy Policy
  3. Discord Alerts: Sends message alerts to your Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Discord Terms | Privacy Policy
  4. Custom Webhooks: Sends alert JSON to administrator-specified webhook endpoints (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n).
  5. Feedback & Diagnostics (Admin Only): Voluntary star ratings and deactivation feedback are sent to https://captain-data-4o8w.onrender.com only when explicitly submitted by an admin. Data includes feedback text, plugin/WP/PHP versions, and optional site URL. Terms | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the captain-live-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen (Plugins → Add New → search “Captain Live Chat”).
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Captain Live Chat → Settings and configure who can act as an agent.
  4. Open Widget Settings to customize the look, welcome screen, contact channels and display rules of your chat widget.
  5. Visit your site and click the chat bubble (bottom-right) to start a test conversation.
  6. Return to Captain Live Chat → Inbox, switch yourself to Online on the Profile page, and reply. The “Get your live chat ready” checklist in the Inbox walks you through these steps.
sections.faq:
Is Captain Live Chat really free? Does it need a subscription?

Yes, it is free and there is no subscription, per-agent fee or message limit. All data stays on your server. An optional Pro add-on exists for teams that want extras like AI auto-replies, Live Visitors, CSAT surveys, email transcripts, conversation export, unlimited canned replies and White Label branding. See Captain Live Chat Pro.

What is the best free live chat plugin for WordPress?

Captain Live Chat is built for site owners who want a free, self-hosted alternative to cloud chat services. You get a real-time chat widget, an agent inbox inside WordPress, WhatsApp and social contact buttons, canned replies, analytics and email or Telegram/Slack/Discord alerts, with all conversations stored in your own database.

How is it different from Tawk.to, Crisp, Tidio or Zendesk chat?

Those are hosted services that store your conversations on their servers and often charge per agent or per feature. Captain Live Chat runs entirely inside your WordPress site: your data stays in your database, there is no third-party chat server, and there is no monthly fee.

Does it work on shared hosting?

Yes. The plugin uses AJAX polling (not WebSockets), which works on all shared hosting providers including Hostinger, Bluehost, SiteGround, and Kinsta. Polling also slows down automatically when a browser tab is in the background to keep server load low.

Can I add a WhatsApp chat button to my website?

Yes. Under the Contact Channels step of the widget wizard, add WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Phone, Email or a custom link. They appear in one unified launcher (Speed Dial, inside the chat panel, or an always-visible stack) so visitors never see overlapping bubbles.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Display Rules can show or hide the chat on the WooCommerce Shop page and on product pages, so you can answer pre-sales questions where they matter most.

Can I run more than one chat widget?

Yes. You can create multiple widgets from templates (Classic Chat and Action Hub), each with its own look, content, contact channels and display rules.

Is data stored on your servers?

No, it is stored on yours. All chat data is stored exclusively in your WordPress database. Captain Live Chat itself makes no external network calls for chat operations and sends visitor conversations to no third-party server.

Does Captain Live Chat send my visitors’ data anywhere?

No. All visitor conversations are stored exclusively in your WordPress database. The core chat engine makes zero third-party AI or cloud server calls. If an administrator explicitly enables optional notification integrations (Telegram, Slack, Discord, Webhooks), new chat alert summaries are sent only to the administrator’s configured webhook destinations. Voluntary admin feedback prompts (rating and deactivation survey) send basic diagnostic details only when explicitly submitted by an administrator.

Can multiple agents reply to chats?

Yes. You can grant chat access by WordPress role (e.g. all Editors) or by selecting individual users, and limit which pages and actions each agent can use. Every agent’s own row in Team Access is protected – you can’t accidentally lock yourself out by removing your own access or restricting your own permissions.

What happens if no agent is online when a visitor writes in?

The widget shows a dedicated offline screen instead of the normal welcome screen: your configured offline message, optional name/email fields, and a custom-text submit button. The message is saved as a real conversation in your Inbox just like any other, so the “Unanswered message reminder” email and normal reply flow both still apply.

Can I customize what the offline lead-capture form asks for?

Yes. In the widget’s content settings, open the Offline tab to edit the welcome message, toggle the name and email fields on or off, and change the submit button text – all with a live preview.

Can I get notified on Telegram, Slack or Discord?

Yes. Under Settings → Integrations you can send new visitor messages to Telegram, Slack, Discord, or any webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n). All integrations are off by default and each has a test button.

Will my visitors’ messages be safe?

All visitor inputs are sanitized server-side using WordPress functions. All AJAX endpoints are protected by nonces, agent actions require capability checks, visitor-facing endpoints are rate-limited to prevent spam, and uploaded files are validated by type and size.

Can I change the widget colours?

Yes, through the Widget Settings wizard’s Appearance step (accent color, launcher icon, position, and panel size), with a live preview on both desktop and mobile.

Does the widget show a “Powered by Captain Live Chat” credit to my visitors?

No, not unless you turn it on. It is off by default. If you’d like to help others discover the plugin, you can enable “Show ‘Powered by Captain Live Chat’ badge” under Settings → Notifications – entirely optional, and you can customize the badge text to whatever you like. It’s always rendered as plain text with no external link, regardless of what text you enter.

Why does the chat widget say “Offline” when I test it?

Visitors see “Online” while at least one agent is switched online. Turn on the Online Status switch on your Profile page (the Inbox checklist also has a “Go online” button). You stay online while any WordPress admin tab is open, also in the background, so you can test the widget in another tab. About two minutes after you close WordPress admin you are shown as away.

How do I hide the chat widget for a while?

Open Widget Settings and use the “Live on website” switch at the top. The chat button disappears from your site straight away; your Inbox and conversations stay as they are. While the widget is off, the Inbox shows a notice with a button to turn it back on.

Does the chat widget show inside Elementor or other page builders?

No. The widget is hidden inside the editors of Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Bricks and Oxygen, so it never covers the page you are editing and a stray click cannot start a real conversation. It shows normally in previews and on the live site. Developers can change this with the captlc_is_page_builder_editor filter.

Can I hide the chat on mobile, on archive pages or on certain pages?

Yes. Open the Display Rules step in Widget Settings. You can switch the chat off per device (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), hide it on page types such as archives, search results or the 404 page, hide or show it on specific pages, posts or products that you pick by title, and target or exclude visitor countries.

Can old conversations be deleted automatically?

Yes. In Settings → Uninstall, set “Auto-delete old conversations” to a number of days. Closed conversations with no activity for that long are permanently erased once a day (messages, attachments, notes and activity log). The default is 0, which keeps conversations forever.

What happens to data when I uninstall?

By default, your data is kept so you don’t lose anything if you reinstall later. If you want a clean removal, turn on “Delete data on uninstall” in Settings before deleting the plugin – this removes all plugin database tables, options, and transients when you click Delete on the Plugins screen. A “Preserve settings on uninstall” option is also available if you want your role/notification preferences to survive a future reinstall while everything else is wiped.

Does it support AI chatbot replies?

AI auto-replies are part of the optional Captain Live Chat Pro add-on. It connects to Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic) or OpenRouter with your own API key, can learn from your Knowledge Base, and answers visitors when no agent is online. The free plugin itself makes no AI calls.

Can AI assistants manage my chats?

Optionally, yes. On WordPress 6.9 or newer, the plugin registers a set of read/management actions as WordPress Abilities via core’s Abilities API. With a separate MCP bridge plugin installed, AI assistants can use those abilities. Every ability requires the “manage_options” capability, is off until you switch it on, and can be individually switched on or off from the plugin’s MCP page (under AI & Automation). This is entirely optional and unrelated to any third-party AI provider – the plugin itself makes no AI API calls.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. Widget texts, error messages, default welcome texts, quick replies and admin screens are translatable, and right-to-left (RTL) languages are supported.

Where can I get help?

Post in the support forum, watch the video tutorials, or join the Facebook community.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3 (22/11/2026)

  • Added: Unified Launcher sharing a single button across live chat and social contact channels (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Call, Email).
  • Added: Three launcher display modes (Speed Dial, Inside Chat Panel, and Always Visible Stack).
  • Added: Multi-channel floating contact buttons with custom positioning.
  • Added: Email notification template customization with dynamic merge tags.
  • Added: Visitor country targeting rules via Cloudflare and GeoIP headers.
  • Improved: Chat Widget wizard with per-widget contact channels in Step 4.
  • Improved: One-click browser notification permission prompt in Settings.
  • Improved: Restructured navigation with new Insights & Tools section.
  • Improved: Admin menu icon styling with currentColor for all WordPress color schemes.
  • Improved: Live visitor accessibility and keyboard navigation.
  • Fixed: Widget table corner clipping and tooltip responsive alignment.

1.1.2 (31/10/2026)

  • Added : AI Agent Setup Guide : Interactive dual-card layout on the AI Agent page combining a quick video guide with feature highlights and upgrade options.
  • Added: Telegram Alerts: Receive real-time Telegram notifications for new visitor messages with easy bot setup, test messaging, and status tracking.
  • Added: Webhook Alerts: Send new visitor messages via JSON to external webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n, custom servers) with optional secret signature verification.
  • Added : Slack Alerts : Post new visitor messages into a Slack channel with a Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Off by default.
  • Added : Discord Alerts : Post new visitor messages into a Discord channel with a Discord webhook URL. Off by default.
  • Added: Integrations Tab: Added a new Settings tab to easily manage, test, and troubleshoot all integrations in one place.
  • Added : Multi-Widget Management : Complete new Chat Widget listing and creation workflow with support for multiple customized chat widgets and templates (Classic Chat & Action Hub).
  • Added : FAQ & Offline Custom Titles : Edit options for FAQ screen header title & badge text, as well as Offline screen title & subtitle directly in Widget Designer.
  • Improved : Live Preview Experience : Sticky preview column that floats smoothly below the WordPress admin bar without cut-off while scrolling through long designer settings..
  • Improved : White Label Support : Seamless integration with agency branding (custom plugin name, author meta, custom help/doc links, and widget branding attribution).
  • Improved : Documentation : Step-by-step guides for Telegram, Webhook, Slack and Discord, shown as numbered steps.
  • Fixed: Cache Clearing: Automatic cache clearing now triggers for popular WordPress caching plugins after saving widget design changes. Manual clearing is still required for server or CDN caches.
  • Fixed : Chat Closure & Restart : “Start a new chat” button after chat closure, allowing users to start a new conversation without clearing browser data.

1.1.1 (07/10/2026)

  • Added : Display Rules : New step in Widget Settings to choose where the chat widget shows – per device (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), per page type (Home, Blog, Posts, Pages, Archives, Search results, 404, WooCommerce Shop and Products), or on specific pages, posts and products picked by title.
  • Added : Live Unread Badge : A red number next to the plugin’s menu item (and next to Inbox) shows how many visitors are waiting for a reply, on every admin screen, and updates by itself.
  • Added : Data Retention : New “Auto-delete old conversations” setting permanently erases closed conversations after the number of days you choose. Off by default.
  • Added : Pop-up Alerts Card : Profile now has a card for pop-up alerts on new messages (each agent can switch them on or off with Captain Live Chat Pro).
  • Added : Getting Started Checklist : New sites see a short “Get your live chat ready” checklist in the Inbox (turn on the widget, go online, send a test message) until the first conversation arrives.
  • Added : Widget On/Off Switch : A “Live on website” switch is always visible at the top of Widget Settings, and the Inbox shows a notice with a “Turn on” button while the widget is off.
  • Added : Session Expiry Notice : The Inbox tells you to reload the page when your login or security token has expired, instead of silently failing.
  • Improved : Background Polling : The chat widget and the Inbox check for new messages less often while the browser tab is in the background, which greatly reduces server load.
  • Improved : Inbox Performance : The Inbox loads faster with many conversations. It lists the most recent ones and keeps the open conversation in the list; older ones are in History.
  • Improved : Widget Assets : The chat widget files are minified and load with defer, so the widget no longer slows down page speed.
  • Improved : Widget Settings : Now 4 steps, with Welcome Screen, Chat View and Offline as tabs inside one “Content” step and a single live preview.
  • Improved : Menu : MCP now sits under AI & Automation, next to AI Agent and Canned Responses. WordPress menu items now use the same names as the plugin sidebar (Widget Settings, Canned Responses), and AI Agent shows a “Pro” tag when Pro is not active.
  • Improved : Agent Presence : Agents stay online while any WordPress admin tab is open, also in the background, instead of going offline as soon as they switch tabs. They are shown as away about two minutes after closing the admin.
  • Improved : Page Builders : The chat widget is no longer shown inside the Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Bricks and Oxygen editors.
  • Improved : Automatic Reply Label : The offline message sent when the AI cannot answer is labelled “Automatic reply” instead of looking like an AI answer.
  • Improved : Settings Page : A short description explains what is in Settings and links to Widget Settings for the chat’s look.
  • Improved : Message Length : Chat messages are limited to 5000 characters to keep conversations fast and stable.
  • Improved : Translations : Widget texts, error messages, default welcome texts and quick replies can now be translated.
  • Improved : Admin Styles : Stylesheets are refreshed in the browser after every update.
  • Security : Public Widget Hardening : File uploads need an active conversation, attachment links must point to the plugin’s own uploads folder, and blocked visitors can no longer send messages or start a new conversation.
  • Security : Permissions : Deleting a conversation requires the “Permanently delete conversations” permission. MCP abilities are now off until the site owner switches them on.
  • Security : Rate Limiting : The FAQ list in the chat widget is rate limited like the other public chat actions, and limits also apply to logged-in visitors.
  • Security : History : The History screen no longer receives the visitor’s private conversation id.
  • Fix : Rate Limiter : Visitors who kept a chat open for a few minutes were locked out with “Too many requests” and could no longer chat.
  • Fix : Deleted Conversations : A visitor whose conversation was deleted (by an agent or by data retention) can now start a new chat instead of being stuck on “Resume chat”.
  • Fix : Inbox Notes : Sample notes from the design mockup no longer appear on conversations without notes.
  • Fix : Inbox Messages : Messages no longer show twice, and the “Conversation reopened” note now appears right away when an agent replies to a closed conversation.
  • Fix : Inbox Errors : Adding or deleting notes and tags, and deleting messages, now show an error when the server refuses instead of a false success message.
  • Fix : Visitor Location : The Inbox no longer shows “India” as the location of every visitor.
  • Fix : Polling Interval : The Widget Settings field now shows the real minimum (2000 ms) that is saved.
  • Fix : Widget Order : The “Conversation reopened” note now appears above the visitor’s reply that reopened the chat.
  • Fix : Pro Detection : “Upgrade to Pro” prompts, PRO tags and the Upgrade menu item are hidden when Captain Live Chat Pro is active.
  • Fix : Canned Responses : Starter replies no longer contain sample usage numbers, prices or an unsupported {pricing_link} tag.
  • Fix : Reminder Emails : Conversations removed from the Inbox no longer trigger reminder emails.
  • Fix : Invalid Data : Malformed requests to save settings, FAQs, schedules or canned replies return “Invalid data” instead of a PHP error.
  • Fix : Uninstall : With “Delete data on uninstall” turned on, all plugin data is removed, including notifications, activity log, notes, tags and uploaded chat attachments.
  • Fix : Profile : “Last active” shows correct singular and plural wording in translations.
  • Fix : Permission Message : The permission-denied message shows proper punctuation instead of raw code characters.

1.1.0 (28/09/2026)

  • Added : Knowledge Base Refresh : The AI Agent Knowledge Base has a “refresh” action to update saved link sources in place without re-adding them.
  • Improved : Admin Loading : Admin app pages load their JavaScript in separate chunks on demand instead of a single large bundle, for a lighter first load.
  • Improved : RTL Styles : CSS stays bundled in a single file so right-to-left (RTL) swapping works on every page.
  • Fix : Auto-Assign : New conversations are assigned to the first agent (or MCP tool) that replies, with no manual claim needed.
  • Fix : Stability : Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.0.0 (24/09/2026)

  • Added : First Release : First stable release.

short_description: Self-hosted live chat for WordPress: agent inbox, WhatsApp & social contact buttons, canned replies, analytics. No subscription, your data.
description:
Captain Live Chat is a free, self-hosted live chat plugin for WordPress. Add a real-time chat widget to your website, answer visitors from a Messenger-style agent inbox inside your WordPress dashboard, and keep every conversation in your own database. No monthly subscription, no per-agent fees, no external chat servers.

Unlike cloud-based services such as Tawk.to, Zendesk, Crisp or Tidio, Captain Live Chat stores all messages, visitor details and attachments on your server. It works out of the box on shared hosting, managed WordPress hosting and VPS, with simple AJAX polling instead of WebSockets.

Whether you run a small business site, a WooCommerce store, a support-heavy SaaS product, or an agency managing chat for multiple clients, you get a lightweight customer support tool that turns website visitors into conversations and leads.

YouTube | X | Facebook Community | Free Support | Captain Live Chat Pro

💬 A Real Live Chat Widget, Not a Contact Form

A floating chat bubble on the front end opens into a real-time conversation: pre-chat form, quick-reply chips, FAQ screen, typing indicators, read receipts, file attachments, and a dedicated offline lead-capture screen (with configurable name and email fields) when no agent is online. Visitors who come back can resume their conversation, and can start a fresh chat after a conversation is closed.

📥 Facebook Messenger–Style Agent Inbox

A modern, React-based dashboard with a thread list and chat panel side by side, plus a visitor info panel (browser, device, location and the live page the visitor is on). Agents add private notes and tags, assign conversations, mention teammates with @mentions, and switch themselves online or offline from their Profile. Agents stay online while any WordPress admin tab is open (also in the background) and go away automatically a couple of minutes after closing the admin. A short “Get your live chat ready” checklist helps new users send their first test message. Reopening a closed conversation, by the visitor or an agent, leaves a permanent, timestamped marker in the transcript.

📱 WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram & Telegram Contact Buttons

Give visitors every way to reach you from one place. Connect WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Phone, Email and custom links into a single unified floating launcher, so visitors never see overlapping bubbles. Choose how the channels appear: Speed Dial fan-out, quick buttons inside the chat panel, or an always-visible stack above the chat toggle. Control order, shape and position, and set channels per widget.

🎨 Multiple Widgets, Templates & a Live-Preview Designer

Create more than one chat widget with ready-made templates (Classic Chat and Action Hub) and customize each one in a step-by-step wizard with a live desktop and mobile preview: accent color, launcher icon, position and size, welcome screen, FAQ screen, chat view, offline experience, contact channels and display rules.

🎯 Smart Display Rules

Show or hide the chat per device (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), per page type (Home, Blog, Posts, Pages, Archives, Search results, 404, WooCommerce Shop and Products), on specific pages, posts and products you pick by title, or by visitor country (via Cloudflare / GeoIP headers). One “Live on website” switch turns the whole widget off, and the widget never shows inside page builder editors (Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Bricks, Oxygen).

🔔 Notifications That Actually Reach Agents

A live red badge next to the plugin’s menu item shows how many visitors are waiting, on every admin screen. Sound alerts, browser push notifications, in-app notifications (conversation reassignment, @mentions) and rate-limited email alerts make sure a new visitor message doesn’t sit unseen. A separate “Unanswered message reminder” re-emails agents if a conversation still hasn’t been answered after a delay you set, including messages left through the offline lead-capture form. Email templates (new message, unanswered reminder, conversation closed) are fully customizable with merge tags.

🔗 Instant Alerts to Telegram, Slack, Discord & Webhooks

Optionally forward new visitor messages to a Telegram chat, Slack channel, Discord channel, or any webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n or your own server), with a built-in test button and status tracking. All integrations are off by default.

👥 Role & User-Based Agent Permissions

Decide exactly who can act as a chat agent, by WordPress role (for example all Editors) or by picking individual users regardless of role. Fine-grained permissions control which pages and actions each agent can use, and every agent’s own Team Access row is protected from accidental self-lockout.

📊 Built-in Analytics, History & Data Retention

Track chat volume, response times and agent performance, and browse full conversation history. Optionally erase old closed conversations automatically after the number of days you choose, and wipe all plugin data on uninstall if you want a clean removal.

🔒 Privacy-Friendly & Secure by Design

All chat data stays in your own WordPress database. Visitor input is sanitized server-side, every AJAX endpoint is protected by nonces and capability checks, public endpoints are rate limited, and file uploads are validated by type and size. The core chat engine makes no third-party calls.

⚡ Lightweight & Shared-Hosting Friendly

The widget is minified and loaded with defer to protect your page speed, and polling slows down automatically while a browser tab is in the background to reduce server load.

🤖 AI-Ready (Abilities API & MCP)

On WordPress 6.9 or newer, the plugin registers its management actions as WordPress Abilities, so an AI assistant (through a separate MCP bridge plugin) can help manage your inbox. Every ability is off until you switch it on and requires the “manage_options” capability.

Perfect for:

  • Small businesses that want live chat without a monthly subscription
  • WooCommerce stores that need to answer pre-sales questions in real time
  • Support teams who need conversation history and analytics in their own database
  • Agencies managing chat for multiple client sites
  • Any WordPress site that wants visitor data to stay on its own server

Key Features

  • 💬 Floating Live Chat Widget : Pre-chat form, quick-reply chips, FAQ screen, typing indicator, read receipts, file attachments, resume and restart chat, and a dedicated offline lead-capture screen
  • 📱 Contact Channels & Unified Launcher : Connect WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Phone, Email, and custom links into a single floating launcher (Speed Dial, inside panel, or visible stack)
  • 🎨 Multi-Widget Designer : Create multiple widgets from templates (Classic Chat, Action Hub) with a step-by-step wizard and live desktop/mobile preview
  • 🎯 Display Rules : Show or hide the chat per device, page type, specific pages, posts and products, or visitor country. One switch turns the whole widget off, and it never shows inside page builder editors
  • 📥 Agent Inbox : Messenger-style thread list and chat panel, real-time polling, private notes, tags, assignment, @mentions, and a visitor info panel (browser, device, location, live current URL)
  • 👥 Role & User Permissions : Grant agent access by WordPress role or by individual user, with page/action permissions and self-lockout protection built in
  • 🔔 Notifications : Live unread badge in the admin menu, sound, browser push, in-app @mentions/reassignment alerts, and rate-limited email for new and unanswered messages
  • ✉️ Customizable Email Templates : Edit the New Message, Unanswered Reminder and Conversation Closed emails with clickable merge tags
  • 🔗 Admin Notification Integrations : Optional instant notifications to Telegram, Slack, Discord, or generic Webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n) when visitors send messages
  • 🟢 Online Status & Auto-Away : Online/offline switch in Profile, presence that stays live across every admin page and background tab, automatic away after the admin is closed
  • 📴 Offline Experience : A configurable lead-capture screen (welcome message, optional name/email fields, custom button text) shown when no agent is online
  • 🔁 Persistent Conversation Timeline : Closed/reopened events are saved permanently in the transcript, in the widget and the Inbox
  • 💡 Canned Replies : Quick, reusable responses with shortcuts and tags for agents
  • 📊 Analytics & History : Chat volume, response times, agent performance, and full conversation history
  • 🗑️ Data Retention : Optionally erase closed conversations automatically after a number of days you choose
  • 🔒 Self-Hosted & Secure : All conversations stay in your own WordPress database. Nonces, capability checks, rate limiting and validated uploads on every endpoint
  • ⚡ Lightweight : Minified, deferred widget scripts and AJAX polling instead of WebSockets, works on any shared host
  • 🌐 Translation & RTL Ready : Widget texts, messages and admin screens can be translated, and right-to-left languages are supported
  • 🤖 Abilities API / MCP Support : Optional, off by default, for AI assistants on WordPress 6.9+

Free vs Pro

Captain Live Chat is complete and fully usable on its own. For teams that want automation and extras, the optional Captain Live Chat Pro add-on appears directly inside your Captain Live Chat dashboard once activated (it requires this free plugin).

Captain Live Chat Pro adds:

  • 🤖 AI Agent Auto-Replies : Answer visitors 24/7 when no agent is online. Bring your own API key for Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic) or OpenRouter
  • 📚 Knowledge Base : Train the AI on your website links and .txt/.pdf documents for accurate, domain-specific answers
  • 🎛️ Custom AI Instructions & Usage Limits : Set tone and boundaries with a custom prompt, and cap daily and per-conversation replies
  • 👀 Live Visitors Dashboard : See who is on your site right now, which pages they view, where they came from, and start proactive chats
  • 👋 Proactive Greetings : Trigger greeting bubbles by time delay, scroll depth or exit intent
  • ⭐ Post-Chat Survey & CSAT : Collect star, thumbs or emoji ratings and track satisfaction in Analytics
  • ✉️ Email Chat Transcripts : Send formatted HTML transcripts to visitors or agents, optionally automatically when a chat is closed
  • 📤 Conversation Export : Export history to CSV or download individual transcripts
  • 🔔 Desktop Pop-up Alerts : Real-time pop-up notifications on any admin screen, with optional audio
  • 🏷️ White Label Branding : Replace the plugin name, author and logo across the admin for client sites
  • ♾️ Unlimited Canned Replies

See all Pro features and pricing

YouTube Tutorials

  • Captain Live Chat – Plugin Overview : See the whole plugin in action – the chat widget on your site, the agent Inbox, notifications, Widget Settings with display rules, canned responses, analytics and history.
  • AI Agent Auto-Reply Setup Tutorial (Pro Add-on) : Step-by-step tutorial for the Captain Live Chat Pro add-on on connecting Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or OpenRouter for intelligent 24/7 automated replies when agents are offline.

🌟 Our Products

🥇 Captain Feed for YouTube : Display customizable YouTube feeds for channels, playlists, Shorts, search results, and individual videos.

🥇 Captain Funnel : Automate WhatsApp messages for WooCommerce orders and form submissions using the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful Elementor widgets and elements.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts and easy customization.

Source Code

The admin dashboard is a React application built with @wordpress/scripts (npm + webpack). The published files in the build/ folder are the compiled output of the human-readable source (JSX/SCSS), which is publicly available at:

https://github.com/devangvachheta/captain-live-chat

To rebuild from source:

  1. Clone the repository above (it includes the src/ folder and package.json).
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies.
  3. Run npm run build to produce fresh files in build/ from the src/ source.
  4. For active development with automatic rebuilds, use npm run start instead.

Usage

After activation:

  1. Set up agents – Under Settings, allow specific WordPress roles or individual users as chat agents.
  2. Customize the widget – Use the Widget Settings wizard to set accent color, welcome screen, chat view, contact channels, and the offline lead-capture experience.
  3. Choose where it shows – Use Display Rules to show the chat only on the devices, pages or countries you want.
  4. Go online – Turn on the Online Status switch on your Profile page so visitors see an active agent. You stay online while WordPress admin is open.
  5. Reply in real time – New visitor messages appear in the Inbox within a few seconds via polling.
  6. Get alerted – Enable sound, browser, email, or Telegram/Slack/Discord/Webhook alerts so no message is missed.
  7. Review performance – Check the Analytics tab for chat volume, response times, and history.

External Services

Captain Live Chat does not connect to external services by default. The chat engine operates entirely within your WordPress installation.

Optional features that send data when explicitly enabled by an administrator:

  1. Telegram Alerts: Sends new message alerts to the Telegram Bot API (https://api.telegram.org). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Telegram Terms | Privacy Policy
  2. Slack Alerts: Sends message alerts to your Slack Incoming Webhook (https://hooks.slack.com). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Slack Terms | Privacy Policy
  3. Discord Alerts: Sends message alerts to your Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com). Data sent: site name, visitor name, message snippet, and dashboard link. Discord Terms | Privacy Policy
  4. Custom Webhooks: Sends alert JSON to administrator-specified webhook endpoints (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n).
  5. Feedback & Diagnostics (Admin Only): Voluntary star ratings and deactivation feedback are sent to https://captain-data-4o8w.onrender.com only when explicitly submitted by an admin. Data includes feedback text, plugin/WP/PHP versions, and optional site URL. Terms | Privacy Policy
